subtitle: A breadcrumb-coated lentil and vegetable burger with chips, suited to vegetarians who prefer familiar flavours and a crisp bite.
quickAnswer: The Wetherspoons breaded vegetable burger costs a typical {price}, contains {calories} kcal and comes in a soft bun with lettuce, tomato and chips. Prices vary by pub. Its lentil, carrot and sweetcorn filling makes this a vegetarian choice with an earthy flavour, gentle sweetness and a crisp breadcrumb coating.

components.name: Breadcrumb coating
components.note: The crisp breadcrumb exterior gives the burger a crunchy bite before you reach the softer vegetable filling.

components.name: Lentil and vegetable filling

components.name: Soft bun

components.name: Chips

taste:
This burger combines a crisp breadcrumb shell with a soft, earthy vegetable centre. Lentils give the filling its savoury character, while carrots and sweetcorn contribute a gentle sweetness. The contrast is its main attraction: a crunchy first bite followed by tender vegetables, rather than the same texture throughout. Served hot, it suits someone looking for a straightforward vegetable burger with familiar flavours.

The soft bun provides a gentler contrast to the coating, with crisp lettuce and tomato alongside the filling. Chips complete the plate with a hearty accompaniment. If your preference is for a veggie burger that tastes of its lentil and vegetable ingredients, this is a useful option to consider.
